description: Header file declaring functions for managing a list of monitor updates, including addition, processing, removal, and clearing of monitor entries identified by UUIDs.

methods.name: mon_list_add
methods.description: Adds a monitor entry identified by uuid with a callback function.

methods.name: mon_list_process
methods.description: Processes monitor entries associated with a specific uuid and updates based on table configuration.

methods.name: mon_list_remove
methods.description: Removes the monitor entry associated with the given uuid.
